name: obsidian-yolo
description: AI chat with note context, smart writing assistance, and one-click edits for your vault.

scripts.dev: npm run runtime:build && npm run module:build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n app,styles,sync -c blue,magenta,yellow "npm:dev:app" "npm:styles:watch" "npm:dev:sync"
scripts.ob: osascript -e 'quit app "Obsidian"' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true && sleep 1 && open -a Obsidian --args --remote-debugging-port=9222 && npm run dev
scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && npm run module:typecheck && npm run runtime:typecheck && npm run styles:build && npm run runtime:build && npm run module:build && node esbuild.config.mjs production && npm run runtime:verify
scripts.prettier:check: prettier --check --cache --cache-strategy content --cache-location node_modules/.cache/.prettiercache src __mocks__ modules/*/src modules/*/module.config.json modules/host-sdk.d.ts modules/tsconfig.json runtime-components/*/src runtime-components/*.ts runtime-components/*.d.ts runtime-components/tsconfig.json runtime-components/*/component.config.json scripts/build-first-party-modules.mjs scripts/build-runtime-components.mjs scripts/verify-runtime-component-boundaries.mjs scripts/runtimeComponentAssetName.mjs scripts/runtimeComponentAssetName.test.mjs scripts/runtimeComponentAssetSources.mjs scripts/runtimeComponentReleaseAssets.mjs scripts/runtimeComponentReleaseAssets.test.mjs scripts/smoke-embedding-engine.mjs scripts/distribution.mjs scripts/distribution.test.mjs scripts/download-stats.mjs scripts/download-stats.test.mjs scripts/release.mjs scripts/release.test.mjs scripts/module-release-assets.mjs scripts/module-release-assets.test.mjs scripts/validate-module-release.mjs scripts/validate-module-release.test.mjs scripts/verify-core-release-assets.mjs scripts/sync-dev-artifacts.mjs scripts/obsidian-agent.mjs .github/workflows/release.yml .github/workflows/module-release.yml .github/workflows/distribution-publish.yml .github/workflows/download-stats.yml package.json app.css eslint.config.mjs postcss.config.cjs
scripts.prettier:write: prettier --write --cache --cache-strategy content --cache-location node_modules/.cache/.prettiercache src __mocks__ modules/*/src modules/*/module.config.json modules/host-sdk.d.ts modules/tsconfig.json runtime-components/*/src runtime-components/*.ts runtime-components/*.d.ts runtime-components/tsconfig.json runtime-components/*/component.config.json scripts/build-first-party-modules.mjs scripts/build-runtime-components.mjs scripts/verify-runtime-component-boundaries.mjs scripts/runtimeComponentAssetName.mjs scripts/runtimeComponentAssetName.test.mjs scripts/runtimeComponentAssetSources.mjs scripts/runtimeComponentReleaseAssets.mjs scripts/runtimeComponentReleaseAssets.test.mjs scripts/smoke-embedding-engine.mjs scripts/distribution.mjs scripts/distribution.test.mjs scripts/download-stats.mjs scripts/download-stats.test.mjs scripts/release.mjs scripts/release.test.mjs scripts/module-release-assets.mjs scripts/module-release-assets.test.mjs scripts/validate-module-release.mjs scripts/validate-module-release.test.mjs scripts/verify-core-release-assets.mjs scripts/sync-dev-artifacts.mjs scripts/obsidian-agent.mjs .github/workflows/release.yml .github/workflows/module-release.yml .github/workflows/distribution-publish.yml .github/workflows/download-stats.yml package.json app.css eslint.config.mjs postcss.config.cjs
scripts.lint:check: npm run prettier:check && eslint --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/.eslintcache-runtime-components src __mocks__ modules/*/src runtime-components/*/src
scripts.lint:fix: npm run prettier:write && eslint --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/.eslintcache-runtime-components --fix src __mocks__ modules/*/src runtime-components/*/src
